![](asset:P000573-stem-1)Two blocks are connected over a massless pulley as shown in figure. The mass of block A is 10 kg and the coefficient of kinetic friction is 0.2. Block A slides down the incline at constant speed.
(i) The mass of the block B in kg is?
(ii) What should be the mass of B if A slides up the slope with constant velocity?

assets.alt: A 10 kg block A on a 30° incline with μ = 0.2, tied by a string over a pulley at the top to block B hanging down the vertical side.
Block A on a 30° incline: T up the slope, 50 N down it, kinetic friction 17.3 N. Notes: (i) A down: T = 50 − 17.3; (ii) A up: T = 50 + 17.3; T = m_B g.
